message:
fix(apk): a key request published late never overwrites a newer one -- coalescing follows the sink's own issue order (epoch, episode, owed token), drops only the older side's causes, never promotes them (keepalive-r2 e, apk-decoder-inbox C r3, Codex codex_apk_inbox_c_src_r2.md N2)

Codex: each producer (RX, the control pass) takes its descriptor from the sink OUTSIDE the ledger lock, so an older ask
can be published after a newer one; DecoderKeyRequest::Merge took the incoming epoch / episode as the newest
unconditionally -- epoch 3 <- a late epoch 2, episode 3 <- a late episode 2: validNew=1 -> validMerged=0 (the newer,
valid ask cancelled with the old one, in held or accepted).

Merge (decoder_key_request.hpp): sink-scoped causes (recovery, codec-up, selection-abort) -- the NEWER sink epoch wins;
the older side's sink-scoped causes are dropped, not carried onto the newer epoch; within one epoch the newer recovery
episode wins, an older episode's recovery bit is dropped. Owed: the newer duty token wins, an older one's bit is dropped.
Pipeline / legacy always kept. The epoch, episode and token only grow (keyEpoch_++, the episode's id_++, the gate's
owedToken_++). No lock, limiter, wire or §8 budget change.
Test build only: NativeVideoClientSession::TestPublishKey(descriptor) -- a whole descriptor through RequestKey.

Tests (each first run against the UNFIXED Merge in this tree -- all FAIL -- then with the fix):
- decoder_key_request_merge_test (new, pure; the API every version has): newer epoch <- late older; newer episode <- late
  older; the issue order; a duplicate; mixed causes (an older recovery goes, codec-up of the same epoch and pipeline stay);
  no promotion (a late epoch-2 recovery is not carried onto epoch 3); owed tokens either order. Unfixed: 5 FAIL. Fixed 8/8.
- android_decoder_inbox_c_test [C12] (product sink, its own states): Codex's (1) episode 3 then a late episode 2 --
  unfixed merged episode=3, valid=0; fixed episode=4 valid=recovery; (2) two aborts with a pick between, the newer
  epoch's ask then the late older one -- unfixed epoch=5 valid=0; fixed epoch=7 valid=abort; the issue order valid.
  Unfixed: 2 FAIL. Fixed 44/44.
- android_decoder_inbox_session_test [S10] (product session + loopback host): a valid ask of the current epoch then an
  older-epoch one published after it -- ACCEPTED (both taken, coalesced before the scheduler's take: its pass held) and
  HELD (the interval spent by a pipeline ask; both refused, merged in held). Unfixed: droppedStale+1, the host gets
  nothing / only the pipeline ask; fixed: sent, droppedStale+0. Fixed 26/26.
